name: CSO_SCHML_JOB_TRACKER
description: This table stores the date information related to processing done by the analytics processor job. It also defines the frequencies at which a particular metric needs to be computed.

columns.name: METRIC_TYPE_ID
columns.description: This is the primary key of the table.

columns.name: METRIC_TYPE
columns.description: This refers to metric type names to be computed by the analytics job processor.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: This is the description of the metric type.

columns.name: HOURLY_ENABLED
columns.description: A flag indicating if this metric is to be calculated at hourly intervals.

columns.name: DAILY_ENABLED
columns.description: A flag indicating if this metric is to be calculated at daily intervals.

columns.name: WEEKLY_ENABLED
columns.description: A flag indicating if this metric is to be calculated at weekly intervals.

columns.name: MONTHLY_ENABLED
columns.description: A flag indicating if this metric is to be calculated at monthly intervals.

columns.name: QUARTERLY_ENABLED
columns.description: A flag indicating if this metric is to be calculated at quarterly intervals.

columns.name: YEARLY_ENABLED
columns.description: A flag indicating if this metric is to be calculated at yearly intervals.

columns.name: LAST_HOURLY_PROC_DATE
columns.description: This indicates the date and time when the metric was last calculated for the hourly interval.

columns.name: LAST_DAILY_PROC_DATE
columns.description: This indicates the date and time when the metric was last calculated for the daily interval.

columns.name: LAST_WEEKLY_PROC_DATE
columns.description: This indicates the date and time when the metric was last calculated for the weekly interval.

columns.name: LAST_MONTHLY_PROC_DATE
columns.description: This indicates the date and time when the metric was last calculated for the monthly interval.

columns.name: LAST_QUARTERLY_PROC_DATE
columns.description: This indicates the date and time when the metric was last calculated for the quarterly interval.

columns.name: LAST_YEARLY_PROC_DATE
columns.description: This indicates the date and time when the metric was last calculated for the yearly interval.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.
